It checks if the provided option is null, in which case it resets the selected option. If there is no currently selected option or the same option is being reselected, it sets the `selected` member variable. 

The issue reported suggests that when the selected option doesn't have a short name, `group.setSelected(option)` doesn't have an effect. To pinpoint the root cause, we need to check how the comparison logic in `OptionGroup.setSelected` interacts with options without short names. I recommend examining the logic in the `OptionGroup.setSelected` method to ensure it handles long-option-only scenarios correctly.

Given the information gathered, it's likely that the problem lies in how the comparison is made with options lacking short names in the `OptionGroup.setSelected` method.
